'''2011 Belgium Regionals Stephane Flamme DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Stephane Flamme]] at [[2011 Belgium Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Blades of Glory v4
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
